help: Billboard ads. See ADS_GUIDE.md. frequency 0..1: the share of the billboards (where it may run) an ad takes; billboards no ad takes show the house designs (houseAds). Images go in client/public/assets/ads/ (wide 1536x512, standard 1024x512, portrait 512x1024, screen 1280x720); an ad without an image for a format uses another one cropped to fit, or its text fallback. url must be https:// (opened in a new tab from the billboard card).
